title: Continuity location
description: How a persistent place is RENDERED. Separate from the location record (LOC-*), which holds where it was and what the evidence says. Ask a generator for the same courtyard three times and you get three courtyards; this record is what makes the fourth match the first. It also carries the forbidden-object list, which is where a period is most often broken — a model will place a plastic vessel or a corrugated roof in an otherwise correct frame without hesitation.

entity.description: The evidence record this renders. Absent for an invented setting under a narrative pack.

era.description: The moment being depicted, not the place's whole history. A location depicted at two periods needs two continuity records — materials, vegetation, and skyline all move.

display.description: How it is spoken or captioned on screen.

wall_construction.description: Technique and finish, not just material. Coursing, temper, render, and tool marks are what make a wall read as built rather than extruded.

openings.description: Doors, windows, thresholds. Frequently unattested — say so here rather than letting the model decide.

state_of_repair.description: Uniform newness is a tell. So is uniform ruin.

materials.description: Every material that may appear in frame. Doubles as the allow-list against which the anachronism pass runs.

appearance.description: Colour, texture, weathering — how it should render, not just what it is.

spatial.description: The geometry a camera has to obey. Getting this wrong is what makes two shots of one place feel like two places.

street_width.description: Or courtyard, room, or plaza dimensions. Drives lens choice and how many figures can plausibly be in frame.

sightlines.description: What is visible from where. The field that keeps a reverse angle consistent with its original.

boundaries.description: What lies immediately beyond frame, so an unplanned wide shot does not invent it.

geometry_asset.description: 3D scene file, if the location is built rather than prompted. Geometry solves this problem outright rather than mitigating it.

vegetation.description: Species and cultivation. A wrong plant is an anachronism a local audience reads instantly, and crops in particular date a scene precisely.

ground_state.description: Dust, mud, standing water. Continuity breaks here constantly and are obvious in a cut.

consistency_rule.description: Whether weather may vary across the production, and where it changes. Silent variation reads as carelessness.

lighting_language.description: Light is what makes a frame read as photographed rather than assembled, and it is where generated imagery most reliably violates physics.

direction.description: Fixed for the location, so every shot in the sequence agrees. Inconsistent light direction is the primary QC check.

practical_sources.description: Fire, lamp, window. Each behaves physically: fire lights warm, moves, and falls off fast.

atmosphere.description: Dust, smoke, haze. Carries depth, and is period-specific.

camera_language.description: How this place is shot. Fixing it per location is a large part of what makes a sequence feel authored rather than assembled.

lens_set.description: From the line's defined set. A defined lens set is the cheapest available purchase of coherence.

movement_rules.description: What movement is permitted here and what motivates it. Unmotivated drift is the signature tell of generated video.

avoid.description: Angles that expose unattested geometry. Framing is the honest tool for uncertainty.

soundscape.description: Ambience asserts what a place sounded like and is reconstruction, held to the same standard as image. Wrong birdsong is an error a local audience hears instantly.

forbidden_sounds.description: Species not present, industry not yet invented, traffic. The audio equivalent of forbidden_objects.

establishing_anchor.description: The canonical wide. Every other angle is checked against it.

source_photography.description: Present-day capture of the real place, if it exists. Classified `contemporary`, never `reconstruction`.

forbidden_objects.description: Things that must NEVER appear in this location. The highest-value field in the record: it is built from what the anachronism pass actually catches, so it compounds across a season and is the one negative list genuinely worth inheriting.

severity.description: 'culturally-prohibited' is a hard stop routed to the sensitivity gate, never a negative-prompt term.

unattested_elements.description: Features the evidence does not cover. Compose around these; do not let the model fill them. This list and camera_language.avoid should agree.

drift_test.description: Evidence the location actually holds across angles. Required at status: locked.

then.description: A locked location must carry its forbidden-object list and a drift test. An empty forbidden list at lock means nobody has run an anachronism pass yet.
